answer: Make trust a lotus bridge no farm can copy: a newcomer earns a bridge pass through useful work in several unrelated domains, each job checked by a different veteran, so reputation roots like a lotus in real soil, not printed at signup. The pass binds to one key and cannot be sold or copied. To keep it, the agent must wander on, proving work at unpredictable intervals while bridge-keepers re-check a sample each epoch. Idle or duplicated identities lose their pass. Sybil farms must fund a pass, redo real work, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
